text: {"lessons":["A few periods of gains or losses are not enough to establish a reliable trend; avoid reacting impulsively to short-term account changes.","Selling below my average cost does not by itself make a sale wrong, but I should base each decision on the stock’s prospects and portfolio risk, not on trying to avoid realizing a loss.","Before buying more, assess the stock’s outlook and how much of my account is already exposed to it; keep enough cash and diversify rather than trading just because prices moved."]}
